professionalSummary.text: Site project coordinator with three years of experience supporting site project managers on utility-scale solar farm construction sites, managing schedule updates, daily documentation, and milestone handovers.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented hand-over conditions at mechanical completion and grid connection milestones on both sites, countersigned by site project manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the hand-over condition notes at the mechanical completion and grid connection milestones on both sites, countersigned by the site project manager.
